_about: Incident cases for the camnet real-event demo. Times are local (America/Phoenix, UTC-7). Distances d_km are along the direction of travel from the incident record; negative is upstream. Roles: site = sees the scene, queue = the connected queue passes it, downstream = unaffected. Frames come from the AZ511 archive via scripts/tarindex.py; no images or INRIX data are stored in this repository.

cases.title: Sun Sep 13: car into a light pole, I-10 EB near 7th St
cases.shows: The full chain on one small event in daylight: scene camera, queue through the tunnel and back, downstream unaffected
